parts.gloss: those who are related as kin

words.gloss: those who are related as kin

literal: Thinking 'they are younger' or 'they are related as kin', without disrespecting, it is fit to behave in accordance with the abiding majesty.
translation: One should not disrespect a ruler thinking, 'He is younger than me,' or 'He is my relative'; rather, one must conduct oneself in accordance with the majestic authority they possess.
modern: அரசர் நமக்கு வயதில் இளையவர் என்றும், நமக்கு உறவினர் என்றும் எண்ணி அவரை மதிக்காமல் இருக்கக் கூடாது; அவருடைய அரச பதவியின் பெருமையைப் போற்றி அதற்கேற்ப நடந்து கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises those who associate with rulers or leaders on how to maintain proper respect. Even if a ruler is younger in age or a close relative, one must not treat them with familiarity or contempt. Instead, one must recognize and respect the sovereign authority and dignity, represented here by 'ஒளி' (majesty or light), that their position holds, and behave accordingly.
